description: [Approved mode — write] This tool creates a record in Pushizo. It only creates a DRAFT and never sends or schedules a message; the API key needs the `mcp:write` scope. Get explicit approval from the user before calling it. Creates an in-app message as `draft`; does not activate it. Example: triggers [{"kind":"session_start"}] (others: session_duration, event, screen, trigger), display {"layout":"modal","blocks":[{"type":"title","text":{"en":"New feature"}},{"type":"body","text":{"en":"Try it now"}},{"type":"button","id":"ok","text":{"en":"OK"},"action":{"type":"dismiss"}}]}.

app_id.description: App ID (app_…). Not needed with an app-scoped key or when a default app is configured.

display.description: Display: layout (modal, banner_top, banner_bottom, fullscreen) + blocks, or content_type "html".
